intentional_cross_biome_exceptions.basis: The approved Bronze weapon uses Fields copper/oak and the level-10 Forest Goblin Brute trophy.
The approved in-place Runite Greatsword preserves its live Ghoul Essence trophy ingredient.
Pre-approved design exception: Desert Runite combines with Evil Woods Cursed Shard at their real boundary.
Froststeel intentionally upgrades the approved Shadowsteel chain with a Winter Frost Crystal.
Wyrmsteel intentionally upgrades the approved Froststeel chain with a Winter Wraith Ice Core.
